tagline.zh: 零基础也能看懂的中英双语复习站：中文讲明白，英文考得出。
tagline.en: Bilingual review sites: understand it in Chinese, answer it in English.

description.zh: 搜索与博弈、监督学习与模型评估、公平性、神经网络与大语言模型。7 讲课 + 5 个实验，全部拆碎了讲。
description.en: Search and game playing, supervised learning and evaluation, fairness, neural networks and LLMs.

description.zh: 数据类型与抽样、分类数据的表格与图、直方图与箱线图、中心与离散、散点图、相关与线性回归。5 个模块从零讲起，按期中选择题的考法练。
description.en: Data and sampling, tables and graphs for categorical data, histograms and boxplots, centre and spread, scatterplots, correlation and linear regression.
